distinguishing_features: Applies a liquid-infused porous coating to well casing and screens rather than dosing the feed with an additive.
Uses the coating to lower silica adhesion so flow can remove incipient deposits in a geothermal reinjection well.
parsed.objective_technical_problem: Reduce silica deposition on reinjection-well surfaces enough to preserve injectivity under operating brine flow.
parsed.viable_reason: The stated wall-shear calculation is dimensionally incorrect, the claimed adhesion threshold is unsupported, and the answer does not establish that the infused layer will persist under geothermal conditions without impairing the screen.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: The closest art already reduces particle cohesion through surface-energy modification, making a surface-applied non-stick coating a predictable application of the same approach.
